current_task_corrections.correction: Set denial_rate_by_segment min_group_size to 30 instead of 50 to flag segments with fewer than 30 claims as statistically unstable and strengthen statistical discipline.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When computing rates by segmented groups, set min_group_size to 30 to flag segments below that threshold as unreliable. This protects against overinterpreting rates from small sample sizes and maintains statistical discipline across analyses.
